purpose.content: The data contract defines exchanged Reading values and their validation and version rules without specifying how a controller orchestrates requests.

fields.boundary: The contract covers serialized Reading values at the Aster export boundary, not operation sequencing or storage technology.
fields.participants: Aster export adapter serializes values and external controllers validate and consume them.

schema.content: A Reading object requires sensorId, utcTimestamp, and celsius; quality is optional and never changes the meaning of celsius or timestamp.

fields.data_shapes: Object fields are sensorId:string, utcTimestamp:UTC ISO8601 string, celsius:number, and optional quality:valid|suspect.
fields.required_fields: sensorId, utcTimestamp, and celsius are required; quality may be absent and null is not a substitute for any required field.

validation.content: Consumers reject unknown sensorId types, non-UTC or missing timestamps, non-finite numbers, unexpected quality values, and mutable shared references.

fields.validation_rules: Require nonempty sensorId, UTC timestamp, finite celsius, valid optional quality, and rejection of non-finite numeric encodings.
fields.invariants: Required fields retain their meanings, timestamps are never synthesized, and schema version does not alter measurement provenance.

compatibility.content: Version 1 requires the three core fields; version 2 adds optional quality. Producers must not require new consumers to understand older version 1 values.

fields.version_policy: Removing or retyping a required field is major; adding optional quality is minor; unknown optional fields may be ignored by consumers.
fields.compatibility_policy: Version 1 consumers accept version 2 objects by ignoring quality, and version 2 consumers accept version 1 objects without quality.

trace.content: The contract traces to the data-model Reading and planned valid, missing-field, non-finite, unknown-quality, and version compatibility cases.

fields.model_elements: The data-model Reading is the fictional semantic source for this serialized contract.
fields.verification_links: Schema validation, required-field, finite-number, optional-quality, and version 1/2 interoperability cases are planned checks.
